statement: ∀ (s a b : ℝ) (f g : KdVPlan.Path), (∀ t ∈ Icc a b, f t = g t) → KdVPlan.ContH s a b f → KdVPlan.ContH s a b g
proof:
intro s a b f g heq hf
constructor
· intro t ht
  rw [← heq t ht]
  exact hf.1 t ht
· intro t ht ε hε
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hd⟩ := hf.2 t ht ε hε
  refine ⟨δ,hδ,?_⟩
  intro r hr hrt
  rw [← heq r hr, ← heq t ht]
  exact hd r hr hrt
